title: cli/serve: `os serve --dev` with `OS_PORT` set still serves the build-time connector `baseUrl` from `/meta` while dispatch reaches the live port (the #26130 split on the serve door)
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location, measured once at a public door. Filed by `domain:server` seat 2 from the out-of-scope findings of the #26130 os-dev report (comment 6421465244, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** #26130 (PR #26240) makes `os dev` compile the config under the boot's own environment, so `/api/v1/meta/connector/…` and dispatch agree on an isolated port. A developer or QA runner who boots with `os serve --dev` instead still gets the old split: Studio, an agent or a runner reading the connector's `baseUrl` from `/meta` sees `3000` while the flow it debugs calls the live port. That is the misdiagnosis #7538 and #26130 were filed to end, left on the second dev door.

**Reader who acts.** The seat owning `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (the dev artifact door) under the lane merge.

## Measured

- **Reach (public door):** on `examples/app-showcase` at `c7aa9cde`, `os serve --dev objectstack.config.ts` with `OS_PORT=41302`, over an artifact built without it: `GET /api/v1/meta/connector/showcase_status_api` served `baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:3000`, while the ping flow's `connector_action` reached 41302.
- **Reading of the code:** `serve.ts` composes the dev artifact door (`devArtifactDoor`) whenever the boot is in dev mode and a local artifact exists, and `serve --dev` compiles nothing. The artifact copy therefore carries the build-time value, and the config module evaluated in the process carries this boot's.

## Expected

- On an `os serve --dev` boot, the connector `baseUrl` served by `/meta` equals the one dispatch uses, by the same means #26130 chose for `os dev` (one evaluation answers both copies), with ⛔ no second copy of the port precedence.
- A pin: an `os serve --dev` boot with `OS_PORT` other than 3000 reads `showcase_status_api`'s served `baseUrl` on that port.

## Dedupe

Searched this repo (open and closed) for "os serve --dev serves build-time connector baseUrl while dispatch uses OS_PORT devArtifactDoor": #26130 (the `os dev` half, open, fix in PR #26240), #26088 (docs port contradiction), #21501 (closed, artifact flag), none this defect.
